import bpy,json,hashlib,struct
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('__PROJECT_ROOT__');blend='assets/scene.blend';asset='app/public/assets/campus.glb';manifest_path='assets/manifest.json';info_path='app/public/assets/build-info.json';level='campus'
assert Path(bpy.data.filepath).resolve()==(root/blend).resolve(),'当前工程不是目标工程，停止导出'
raw=(root/'planning/project.json').read_bytes();plan=json.loads(raw);digest=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest();manifest=json.loads((root/manifest_path).read_text())
actual_triangles=sum(len(p.vertices)-2 for obj in bpy.data.objects if obj.type=='MESH' for p in obj.data.polygons)
assert actual_triangles==manifest['triangles'],'几何数量不符，停止'
if level=='campus':
 for identity in plan['demoDesign']['buildingIdentities']:
  obj=bpy.data.objects['building_'+identity['id']];expected=plan['production']['geometryById'][identity['id']]['position'];assert all(abs(a-b)<.001 for a,b in zip(obj.location,expected))
target=root/asset;pending=root/'work/mcp'/('validated-'+level+'.glb')
# MCP连接状态属于工具运行数据，不导出到业务GLB。
scene=bpy.context.scene;transient={key:scene[key] for key in scene.keys() if key.startswith('blendermcp_')}
for key in transient:del scene[key]
try:
 bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=str(pending),export_format='GLB',export_yup=True,export_extras=True,export_cameras=False,export_lights=False,export_apply=True)
finally:
 for key,value in transient.items():scene[key]=value
previous=hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest();actual=hashlib.sha256(pending.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def payload(path):
 data=path.read_bytes();size=struct.unpack_from('<I',data,12)[0];document=json.loads(data[20:20+size])
 for item in document.get('scenes',[]):
  extra=item.get('extras',{})
  if extra.get('blendermcp_server_running') in (1,True):extra.pop('blendermcp_server_running')
  if not extra:item.pop('extras',None)
 return document,data[28+size:]
assert payload(target)==payload(pending),'除已知MCP运行标记外有内容变化，保留主模型并停止同步'

manifest['planningSha256']=digest;manifest['execution']='MCP核对导出；GLB哈希不变，样区未启用到主场景'
if level=='campus':
 manifest['files']={f:{'bytes':(root/f).stat().st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256((root/f).read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for f in [blend,asset]}
 info=json.loads((root/info_path).read_text());info['planningSha256']=digest
else:info=manifest
(root/info_path).write_text(json.dumps(info,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');(root/manifest_path).write_text(json.dumps(manifest,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n')
